---
title: "Observable slider"
date: "2026-08-20"
categories: [observablejs]
draft: true
---

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

data = Array.from(
  {length: 1000},
  () => ({rating: Math.random() * 10 + 1})
)

viewof binCount = Inputs.range(
  [5, 50],
  {value: 20, step: 1, label: "Bins:"}
)

Plot.plot({
  title: "Distribution of ratings",
  titleFontSize: 22,
  width: 700,
  height: 400,
  
  marginTop: 50,
  marginRight: 30,
  marginBottom: 60,
  marginLeft: 70,
  
  style: {
    fontFamily: "Arial, sans-serif",
    fontSize: "16px"
  },
  
  x: {
    label: "Rating",
    tickFormat: d => d.toFixed(1),
    tickSize: 5,
    labelFontSize: 12,
    tickFontSize: 14
  },
  y: {
    label: "Number of observations",
    grid: true,
    labelFontSize: 18,
    tickFontSize: 14
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(
      data,
      Plot.binX(
        {y: "count"},
        {
          x: "rating",
          thresholds: binCount,
          fill: "steelblue",
          fillOpacity: 0.65,
          stroke: "white"
        }
      )
    ),
    Plot.tip(
      data,
      Plot.pointerX(
        Plot.binX(
          {y: "count"},
          {
            x: "rating",
            thresholds: binCount
          }
        )
      )
    )
  ]
})

```
